title: Ruin
description: Produced and mixed in 60 minutes; finalist for mix clarity and production quality. Ableton Live with a template-based workflow for speed, final balance on Pro Tools via Avid S6 for tactile signal processing.

title: Mess I've Left Behind
description: Directed a live recording session for an 8-piece ensemble (6 violins, 1 cello, 1 banjo): coordinated mic placement, sheet music distribution, and talent communication. CeVIO AI (KAFU) integrated as lead vocal, mixed to blend organic and synthetic textures. Mixed by Riley Finkle.

title: Taste of Candy
description: Ballad vocal synthesis via Hatsune Miku on Synthesizer V. Extensive manual tuning of phonemes, pitch curves, vibrato, dynamics, and brightness to eliminate robotic artifacts. iZotope RX9 for noise floor management within a dense arrangement.

title: LOONA - Flip That
description: A house/future bass remix of a K-pop song. RX9 for vocal isolation and Ableton Live for arrangement.

title: Forget Me
description: My first track using Synthesizer V to use Hatsune Miku. Includes heavy use of vocoding to create a rough but slim texture, as well as a violin solo.

title: Out of Love
description: A revisit to Miku, learning the depths and details of vocaloid synthesis. The primary focus was on 'tuning' in Synthesizer V, adjusting phonemes and pitch curves to stylize the performance.
